newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: WING TAI UNIT RAISES STAKE IN HK COMPANY.
newsitem.headline: WING TAI UNIT RAISES STAKE IN HK COMPANY.

text.p: Wing Tai Holdings Ltd said on Friday its wholly-owned subsidiary Wing Tai Garment Manufactory (S) Pte Ltd (WTG) had raised its stake in a Hong Kong company.
It said in a statement WTG bought one million shares of HK$0.50 each in USI Holdings Ltd for HK$2.36 million.
USI is an associate company listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong.
After the acquisition, WTG owns a total of 4.25 million ordinary shares in USI, representing 0.82 percent of the issued share capital in USI, the statement said.
Brave Dragon Ltd, another unit of Wing Tai, owns another 104.69 million shares in USI, representing 20.23 percent of the issued share capital in USI.
Wing Tai said the purchase was not expected to have any material effect on its net tangible assets and earnings per share for the current financial year ending June 30, 1998.
